items.exampleEn: Winning the prize raised his status at school.
items.exampleZh: 得獎提高了他在學校的地位。

items.exampleEn: Teenagers often want to be more independent.
items.exampleZh: 青少年常常想要更獨立。

items.exampleEn: Christmas is an important Christian holiday.
items.exampleZh: 聖誕節是重要的基督教節日。

items.exampleEn: She studies the religion of ancient Egypt.
Children's stories often end with a moral.
items.exampleZh: 兒童故事常常在結尾帶出一個寓意。

items.exampleEn: In a democracy, people choose their leaders by voting.
items.exampleZh: 在民主制度中，人們透過投票選出領導者。
她的家庭有著保守的價值觀。

items.exampleEn: Industrial waste can make rivers dirty.
items.exampleZh: 工業廢棄物會讓河川變髒。

items.sentenceEn: Religion is an important part of her life.
items.sentenceZh: 宗教是她生活中很重要的一部分。

items.audioEn: You can check the status of your order on our website after six p.m.
items.audioZh: 晚上六點以後，你可以在我們的網站上查詢訂單狀態。
items.questionZh: 什麼時候可以上網查訂單狀態？

items.sentenceEn: Old industrial buildings are now used as art studios.
items.sentenceZh: 舊的工業建築現在被當成藝術工作室。

items.sentenceEn: He wore a conservative black suit to the interview.
items.sentenceZh: 他穿了一套保守的黑色西裝去面試。

items.stemEn: The ____ of the story is that we should always be kind.
items.stemZh: 這個故事的寓意是我們應該永遠待人和善。

items.stemEn: After moving out, she became more ____ and learned to cook for herself.
items.stemZh: 搬出去住以後，她變得更獨立，也學會自己煮飯。

items.passageEn: Last week, our class visited a museum about our city's history. It is in a historic building near the river. Two hundred years ago, the city was a small farming town. Then it became an industrial center with many factories. One room showed how Christians and people of other religions lived side by side. Another room explained the history of democracy in the city. Our guide said that in the past, women had a low status, and few of them could be independent. At the end, our teacher asked us what the moral of the city's story was. I said that things can change, even when people are conservative at first.
items.passageZh: 上週我們班參觀了一間介紹我們城市歷史的博物館，它位在河邊一棟具歷史意義的建築裡。兩百年前，這座城市是個小小的農業城鎮，後來成了有很多工廠的工業中心。有一個展間介紹基督徒和其他宗教的人如何比鄰而居。另一個展間說明這座城市民主制度的歷史。導覽員說，過去女性地位很低，很少有人能獨立。最後，老師問我們這座城市的故事有什麼寓意。我說，即使人們一開始很保守，事情還是會改變。

questions.questionZh: 兩百年前這座城市是什麼樣子？
options: 一個熱鬧的國際貿易港口
一座有很多工廠的工業城市

questions.questionZh: 作者認為這座城市的故事有什麼寓意？

items.promptZh: 很多基督徒每週日上教堂。
referenceEn: Many Christians go to church every Sunday.
Lots of Christians go to church on Sundays.
rubricZh: Christian 表示「基督徒」，例如 Many Christians… 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說習慣用現在簡單式等）

items.promptZh: 在這個國家，老師的社會地位很高。
referenceEn: Teachers have a high social status in this country.
In this country, teachers have high status in society.
rubricZh: 用 status 表示「地位」（例如 a high social status）
「社會地位」可寫，例如 social status、status in society 等
